_comment: Documentary template of the auto-updater feed for ABACO DEEP HARNES. electron-updater consumes YAML (latest-mac.yml / latest.yml), not JSON; release-mac.sh builds the real feed from the emitted electron-builder artifacts and merges the per-arch metadata (see desktop/src/dsh-desktop/scripts/merge-mac-update-metadata.mjs). This file is here so the shape of the feed is documented alongside the build pipeline.
